verdict.rationale: Vanta's risk product documents an in-platform risk register: it offers 100+ pre-built risk scenarios with suggested control mappings, or you can import an existing register (vanta-docs-87). It also automates reminders and workflows for regular reassessment (vanta-docs-22) and runs risk processes from one central platform (vanta-docs-48), which covers the register, the control linkage and the review cycles. Missing for 10: documented risk scoring/likelihood-impact methodology, treatment plans, per-risk owner assignment, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
